description: Current gas price and base fee on Base mainnet, read at a named block, with the cost of a plain value transfer computed for you. An optional window of up to 30 recent blocks adds the median, minimum and maximum base fee, so a caller can ask 'right now' or 'this hour'. Choose this to price a transaction before sending it: current gas price, base fee and the cost of a 21000-gas transfer, read at a named block, optionally with a median over a window of recent blocks. Do not choose this for Ethereum mainnet, for L2 fee comparisons, or for the gas a specific contract call will use: it reports Base mainnet's gas market and a plain transfer's cost. Example requests: What is gas on Base right now? | How much does a simple transfer cost on Base at the current base fee? | What has the Base base fee been over the last 20 blocks?

accepted_price.description: The quoted amount, echoed exactly; checked against the quote.

authorized_by.description: Identifier of the human or agent authorizing this job.

buyer_token.description: The buyer_token returned with your first purchase. It opens the purchase history for that buyer, including earlier deliverables.

idempotency_key.description: Retry key; the same key returns the same job.

window.description: Optional: how many recent blocks to include in the base-fee statistics, 1 to 30. Default 1 (the latest block only).

payment_signature.description: x402 payment payload; required for a priced capability (see submit_job).

quote_id.description: The quote_id from POST /v1/jobs; required when priced.
